notes.title: The alpha version teaser exhibited at TGS2023 has been posted on Steam.
notes.notes:
The alpha version teaser exhibited at TGS2023 has been posted on Steam.

This is our first progress report, three months after our development was announced.
We are still in the early stages of development, so we haven't been able to do everything we wanted to do, but we would like to let you know that our development is definitely moving forward.

Please let us know your thoughts.
